title: QuickLoot
description: This project adds Rust-style quick looting to Minecraft containers. Hold H while hovering over items to queue them for transfer, with a green circular timer moving stacks into the chest or back into your inventory one after another.
body:
![preview duh](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cc4f0e66cb7599480d4de55b12da0b57f87ac2f3.gif)

QuickLoot adds a Rust-style hover looting system to Minecraft container screens.

Hold `H` while hovering over item slots to queue them for transfer. A green circular timer appears over queued items, and each stack moves one at a time when its timer completes. Items move using Minecraft’s normal quick-move behavior, so stacks merge into existing stacks first when possible, then fill open slots.

Works both ways:
- Chest to inventory
- Inventory to chest

The first side you start hovering from stays locked until you release `H`, which helps prevent accidentally moving items back and forth while sweeping across slots.
